Name: Shie-Esque Mister Ginger Portrait
Author: Stephamoeba
Description:
A portrait mod for Lemurkat's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger (cat NPC)[/url]﻿ mod.
I tried my best to imitates Shielia's art style from their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/url]﻿ mod﻿.
This Content Patcher file should work, but if it doesn't please let me know!

If you are looking for a Content Patcher forms of Shie's portraits...[list]
[*][url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8361]Shie's Portraits for Content Patcher by leifcg[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9635]﻿Shie's Portraits for SVE Content Patcher by AlmostMidnight﻿[/url]
[/list]
But please support the original creator's work as well!

MOD REQUIREMENTS:[list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
[*]PyTK (Platonymous Toolkit)
[*]SHIE'S PORTRAITS
[*]Mister Ginger (cat NPC)
[/list]

INSTALLATION GUIDE:
Simply download the zip folder, unzip it, and place the unzipped folder within your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
(Example: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
